ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT ofn2320 2025,by and between AUTOMOTIVE REALTY CORPORATION, a corporation having an office at 573 East Fordham Road, Bronx, NY 10458 ("Owner") and 528 EAST FORDHAM ROAD LLC, a limited liability company, having an office at 135 Pine Aire Drive, Bay Shore, New York 11706 (Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes referred to hereinafter individually as a“Party”or collectively as the “Parties"). RECITALS: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of that certain parcel of land in the Borough of the Bronx,County of the Bronx,City and State ofNewYork,known as and by the street address 540 East Fordham Road,Bronx,NewYork,identified as Block 3059,Lot 36 on the TaxMap of the City of New York (the“Tax Map")("Owner's Parcel"), which parcel is more particularly described in Exhibit “A”annexed hereto and made a part hereof; with said buildings with any improvements, future additions, alterations and replacements thereof on the Owner's Parcel being hereinafter referred to as the “Owner's Building.”" and said Owner's Parcel and Owner's Building being hereinafter referred to as the“Owner's Property”; WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of that certain parcel of land in the Borough of the Bronx, County of the Bronx, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address528EastFordham Road,Bronx,NewYork,identified as Block 3059,Lot 32on the Tax Map ("Developer's Parcel"), which parcel is more particularly described in Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof; with said buildings and improvements on the Developer's Building being hereinafter referred to as the“Developer's Property;” WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish in whole or in part, Developer's Building and to construct a new building upon all or a portion of Developer's Parcel (said new building, with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being hereinafter referred to as the "New Building"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more “floor area", as such term is defined in Section 12-10 the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961, as amended, and as the same may be amended from time to time ("Zoning Resolution"), than is currently available for use on Developer's Parcel (if such Developer's Parcel was a separate zoning lot); WHEREAS, accordingly, the parties hereto desire to utilize the procedures set forth in the Zoning Resolution for combining the Owner's Parcel and the Developer'sParcel to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") so as to make available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) available to Developer for utilization in connection with the construction andmaintenanceoftheNewBuilding;
